sql:
SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', e.event_date) = '2019' THEN b.spent ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', e.event_date) = '2020' THEN b.spent ELSE 0 END) AS difference_spent
FROM 
    event e
JOIN 
    budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
WHERE 
    e.type = 'Student_Club'
